text:
Predicates:
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
Loan(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Club(x) ::: x is a football club.
SameClub(x, y) ::: x is a football club along with y.
Premises:
FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ Loan(ailtonSilva, braga) ::: Ailton Silva is a football player who was loaned out to Braga.
FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Nautico.
Club(nautico) ∧ Club(braga) ∧ SameClub(nautico, braga) ::: Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
Club(fluminense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (FootballPlayer(x) ∧ ¬∃y (Club(y) ∧ PlaysFor(x, y))) ::: Ailton Silva does not play for a football club.
